content.scope: Original Chinese explanation of PEAR/RURL, coordinate increments, group filtering and conditional task weights, asynchronous updates, curriculum, transfer evidence and deployment timing.

validation.production_build: Hugo 0.165.0, minified, fresh temporary destination, at most two workers
validation.filter_inventory: 110 published posts, 11 topics; exact metadata and learning-path coverage
validation.search: Shared search unit checks and PEAR discovery from both language entrances
validation.browser_reading: 96 layouts: scripts on/off, 320/390/768/1440 pixels, three themes, 100/200 percent text, ordinary/increased spacing
validation.discovery: 18 scoped contexts covering native/enhanced home cards in both languages, blog index, PEAR taxonomy, filter URL and article metadata
validation.keyboard_and_fallbacks: Native number controls, Enter/Space, Tab order, invalid recovery, stale-value clearing, endpoints, all overflowing formula/table regions, three image viewers, blocked/late numeric script and restored invalid inputs
validation.focus: 252 painted-outline cases including ordinary and light/dark forced-color palettes
validation.touch: 24 browser-emulated contexts, 36 preset taps, 24 horizontal-table/vertical-page gesture pairs; not physical-device validation
validation.native_print: 24 production PDFs plus 24 forced-color draft PDFs: A4/Letter, three themes, 100/200 percent text and scripts on/off; six result label/value pairs checked in every PDF
validation.print_geometry: 24 ordinary and 24 forced-color layouts, including formula/table/code bounds, white paper and text contrast
validation.manual_pdf_review: Ten selected pages rasterized across ordinary A4, enlarged native Letter and forced-color A4; action table, probability results, perturbation comparison, trial figure, formulas and downloadable-code usage inspected
validation.semantic_rules: Pinned axe-core 4.14.0: zero violations. One closed-dialog incomplete rule with three image links was resolved by confirming every referenced dialog and testing open/Escape/focus restoration.
validation.numerical_examples: 77 exact binomial cases, all 256 binary groups of eight with Decimal advantages, coordinate/rotation, Wilson score endpoints, task-mixture and score-centering checks
validation.browser_calculator_oracle: 344 valid and 13 invalid cases against independent exact Python binomial enumeration, plus extreme values and static-default agreement
validation.figure_checks: 303 probability-curve cases and declared real-trial counts; independent re-render produces identical SVG bytes
validation.fixed_source_probe: Pinned commit and nine source hashes; pure protocol, selected AST methods and manifest products checked with bounded recorders. No dataset framework or training script executed.
validation.probe_guards: Seven passed checks: valid source, existing-output preservation, source/manifest tampering rejection before execution, wrong-revision rejection, missing-source behavior and no bytecode.
validation.citation_links: 18 unique citation targets: immutable Git paths verified locally; project, paper and model collection opened read-only. Local Hugging Face TLS timeout was resolved through the web reader.

manifest_products.scope: Pinned task/initial-state row products, not actual scheduler frequencies or retained rollout proportions.

limits: No model weights, policy training, simulator, GPU kernel, IK solver or robot device was run.
Fixed IID probability examples do not measure training candidate counts or throughput. Conditional retained success is distinct from evaluation success.
Wilson intervals are additional IID illustrations; fixed repeated scenes do not establish that assumption or real-robot coverage.
Quality uses BF16 while quoted original deployment throughput uses NVFP4 plus DFlash2. Fixed-token division is not an observed full-round latency.
Current published recipe defaults differ from paper configuration. Source observations are pinned, rather than attributed to all future revisions.

Native Chrome printing can shift the no-script reading position. The driver records that delta; it asserts exact position restoration only with page scripts, while checking values and focus in both modes.
resource_policy: Heavy work serialized under /home/ubuntu/.cache/codex-heavy-work.lock, resource reserve checked after acquisition, numeric threads one, Hugo at most two workers, browser drivers serial. Temporary previews stopped after each stage.
